The page does not change

The data-theme goes on the <nav>, so daisyUI resolves its colour variables against the sidebar and leaves the rest of the page on the document's theme.

Open Configuration at the bottom of the sidebar: the floating panel is what gets lost over a dark surface if nobody gives it a border — daisyUI's soft shadow is invisible against a dark background.
